column5: 第一步：打开手套箱，向右拨动香氛盒开关按钮

column5: 第二步：向下取下香氛盒，在香氛盒内安装香氛胶囊

column5: 请先开启前排主驾吹面或吹脚模式

column4: Turn on passenger face mode first
column5: 请先开启副驾吹面模式

column4: Warning! Never leave children or pets alone in the vehicle! Cabin Overheat Protection cannot prevent heat injury or death
column5: 警告！不要把儿童或宠物独自留在车内！座舱主动控温系统无法避免生物受热损伤或死亡

column4: Requires an energizing fragrance (e.g. No. 9). When driver fatigue is detected, this fragrance turns on automatically
column5: 此功能开启需要安装9号香水等提神醒脑类香氛，当系统监测到驾驶员疲劳时会自动开启此类香氛

column4: Monitors cabin CO₂ level and alerts you according to its level
column5: 监测车内CO₂浓度并且根据浓度等级进行提醒

column4: Alerts you when open windows reduce climate performance
column5: 如果车窗开启影响空调性能，系统将自动提醒

column4: For up to 24 hours after you leave the vehicle, cabin temperature is kept below 40℃. Not available when battery is at 20% or lower
column5: 在离开车辆后的最长24小时内，座舱温度将保持在40℃以下。当电池电量降低至20%或以下时，此功能无效

column4: Monitors cabin PM2.5 level and alerts you according to its level
column5: 监测车内PM2.5浓度并且根据浓度等级进行提醒

column4: Heats the wheel automatically when cold. Not in Eco mode
column5: 低温自动开启方向盘加热，经济驾驶模式开启时此功能无效

column4: Double-tap a vent area to close airflow
column5: 双击出风口区域可关闭出风

column4: Cannot switch now. Exit car wash mode and try again
